problem: Flow lacks a safe review amendment and allowed two invalid planning contracts to survive until later Delivery gates.
intended_users: Flow operators, reviewers, maintainers, and the bounded Delivery Lead.
outcomes: Implement the constrained amendment, move all three observed bootstrap failures to early gates, and complete the blocked MAF review.
scope: Review amendment capability, definition validation ordering, chartered-job planning validation, tests, documentation, and real-run application.
exclusions: General artifact editing, multiple amendment generations, macOS baseline repair, MAF redesign, and manual implementation substitution.
constraints: Implementation uses the generic chartered Delivery Lead gateway and an isolated worker worktree.
assumptions: The generic chartered-job gateway supports a clean baseline and test_flow.py as its targeted proof.
acceptance_criteria: AC1-AC8 in this run plus AC1-AC10 in review-provenance-refinement-2.

risks.risk: Lifecycle amendment code could expand authority or invalidate historical evidence.
